newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 23.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Premier Lien Chan says no restriction on topics to be discussed in national development meetings to be held during November 1-24.
Ruling Nationalist Party says it would welecome Chinese dissident Wang Xizhe to join party if Wang identifies himself with Taiwan's Republic of China government.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Chinese dissident Wang Xizhe says he intends to join Nationalist Party.
Central bank will not lead interest rates to fall lower.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Parliament reviews Labour Standard Law revision, which would expand scope to several additional industries.
Taiwan considers allowing foreign vessels to extend routes to other third places after sailing between Taiwan and China.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan monetary policy will not be loosened further.
Taiwan Taffeta Fabric reports T$120 million share payment default.
